description: Defines the srs_channel_matrix class for representing and manipulating wideband channel matrices estimated from SRS signals, including constructors, accessors, normalization, and comparison methods.

classes.name: srs_channel_matrix
classes.description: Represents a wideband estimated channel matrix based on SRS signals, supporting construction, normalization, comparison, and coefficient access.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix()
methods.description: Default constructor creating an empty channel matrix.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix(unsigned nof_rx_ports, unsigned nof_tx_ports)
methods.description: Constructs a zero-initialized channel matrix with specified receive and transmit ports.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix(const std::initializer_list<cf_t>& coefficients, unsigned nof_rx_ports, unsigned nof_tx_ports)
methods.description: Constructs a channel matrix with provided coefficients, specified by an initializer list.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix(span<const cf_t> coefficients, unsigned nof_rx_ports, unsigned nof_tx_ports)
methods.description: Constructs a channel matrix with provided coefficients, specified by a span.

methods.name: operator=(const srs_channel_matrix& other)
methods.description: Assignment operator to copy another channel matrix.

methods.name: is_near(const srs_channel_matrix& other, float tolerance) const
methods.description: Checks if two matrices are similar within a given tolerance based on Frobenius norm.

methods.name: get_nof_rx_ports() const
methods.description: Returns the number of receive ports.

methods.name: get_nof_tx_ports() const
methods.description: Returns the number of transmit ports.

methods.name: get_coefficient(unsigned i_rx_port, unsigned i_tx_port) const
methods.description: Retrieves the coefficient for specified receive and transmit port indices.

methods.name: set_coefficient(cf_t coefficient, unsigned i_rx_port, unsigned i_tx_port)
methods.description: Sets the coefficient for specified receive and transmit port indices.

methods.name: operator*=(float scale)
methods.description: Scales all coefficients by a real factor.

methods.name: operator*=(cf_t scale)
methods.description: Scales all coefficients by a complex factor.

methods.name: frobenius_norm() const
methods.description: Calculates the Frobenius norm of the matrix.

methods.name: operator-(const srs_channel_matrix& other) const
methods.description: Subtracts another matrix from this one.

methods.name: normalize() const
methods.description: Returns a normalized version of the matrix with specific scaling.
